id.description: Exception item's identifier. Either `id` or `item_id` must be specified

item_id.description: Human readable exception item string identifier, e.g. `trusted-linux-processes`. Either `id` or `item_id` must be specified

namespace_type.description: `single` deletes the item in the current Kibana space; `agnostic` deletes an item in a space-agnostic list. Must match the list that owns the item.
